description: Composite of four simulation panels (a)-(d) from a 3D cellular-automaton model, each panel containing TWO stacked line plots (upper: ε₁ = 0.2; lower: ε₁ = 0.4) of Average grain size (µm) versus True strain (0.2-0.9); every sub-plot is annotated "DRX grains" and carries a three-entry legend. (a) T: 950 °C — Constant(0.1 s⁻¹) solid purple, First stage(0.01 s⁻¹) dashed orange, Second stage(0.1 s⁻¹) dashed green: the first-stage curve sits far above the constant curve (near the 70 µm gridline) and the second-stage curve climbs from almost zero to merge with it. (b) ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹ — Constant(950 °C), First stage(1050 °C), Second stage(950 °C): the 1050 °C curve starts near the 100 µm gridline and falls steadily, while the 950 °C second-stage curve rises from near zero to the constant level. (c) T: 950 °C — Constant(0.01 s⁻¹), First stage(0.1 s⁻¹), Second stage(0.01 s⁻¹): the first-stage curve begins below the constant curve then converges, second stage rises from zero. (d) ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹ — Constant(1050 °C), First stage(950 °C), Second stage(1050 °C). In all ε₁ = 0.4 lower plots the second-stage curve is delayed, staying near zero until strain ≈0.4.

subfigures.description: T: 950 °C, ε₁: 0.2; average grain size vs true strain. Dashed orange First stage(0.01 s⁻¹) lies near the 70 µm gridline and stays above the solid purple Constant(0.1 s⁻¹), which peaks near the 35-40 µm level; dashed green Second stage(0.1 s⁻¹) starts near 0 µm at strain 0.2 and rises to the constant level by ~strain 0.5.

T: 950 °C, ε₁: 0.4; same legend. First-stage curve again far above the constant curve; the second-stage green curve stays at ~0 µm until about strain 0.4 before rising steeply to meet the constant curve near strain 0.6.

ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹, ε₁: 0.2; legend Constant(950 °C), First stage(1050 °C), Second stage(950 °C). Orange first-stage curve starts highest (near the 100 µm gridline) and declines monotonically; green second-stage rises from low values to converge with the purple constant curve at high strain.
ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹, ε₁: 0.4; the 1050 °C first-stage curve again starts near 100 µm and decreases; the 950 °C second-stage curve is delayed, beginning to rise only after strain ≈0.4.

T: 950 °C, ε₁: 0.2; legend Constant(0.01 s⁻¹), First stage(0.1 s⁻¹), Second stage(0.01 s⁻¹). Purple constant curve peaks around 70 µm near strain 0.3; orange first-stage starts well below it then converges; green second-stage rises from ~0-15 µm to join the constant curve.
T: 950 °C, ε₁: 0.4; constant curve highest at low strain; second-stage green curve stays near zero until about strain 0.4, then rises steeply towards the other curves.

ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹, ε₁: 0.2; legend Constant(1050 °C), First stage(950 °C), Second stage(1050 °C). The green 1050 °C second-stage curve rises steeply to the high constant level, while the orange 950 °C first-stage curve rises more gradually and levels off lower.

ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹, ε₁: 0.4; same legend; the orange first-stage curve starts near zero and increases slowly, while the green second-stage curve again climbs to the constant-curve level after a delayed onset.

observations.observation: Each of the four panels (a)-(d) is composed of two stacked line plots, the upper for ε₁: 0.2 and the lower for ε₁: 0.4, both annotated 'DRX grains'.
The horizontal axis of every sub-plot is 'True strain' running from 0.2 to 0.9 and the vertical axis is 'Average grain size(µm)'; visible gridline labels are 0, 35, 70 and 105 µm.
Panel (a) legends read Constant(0.1 s⁻¹) (solid purple), First stage(0.01 s⁻¹) (dashed orange) and Second stage(0.1 s⁻¹) (dashed green); panel (a) is headed T: 950 °C.
Panel (b) legends read Constant(950 °C), First stage(1050 °C) and Second stage(950 °C), with ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹ printed at the top left of each sub-plot.
Panel (c) legends read Constant(0.01 s⁻¹), First stage(0.1 s⁻¹) and Second stage(0.01 s⁻¹), with T: 950 °C printed at the top left of each sub-plot.
Panel (d) legends read Constant(1050 °C), First stage(950 °C) and Second stage(1050 °C), with ε̇: 0.01 s⁻¹ printed at the top left of each sub-plot.

In panels (a) and (b) the 'First stage' curve lies well above the corresponding 'Constant' curve over most of the strain range, whereas in panels (c) and (d) the 'First stage' curve starts below the 'Constant' curve and converges towards it at high strain.
In every panel the 'Second stage' dashed curve begins near the bottom of the axis and rises to merge with the corresponding 'Constant' curve at high strain.
No numeric data labels or point markers are printed on any curve; grain-size values can only be read against the 35/70/105 µm gridlines, so exact values are not recoverable from the pixels.
The caption states (a) shows the transiently increasing strain rate from 0.01 s⁻¹ to 0.1 s⁻¹ at 0.2 or 0.4 strains at 950 °C.
The caption states (b) shows decreasing temperatures from 1050 °C to 950 °C in strain ranges of 0.2-0.3 or 0.4-0.5 at 0.01 s⁻¹.

The caption states (c) shows the transiently decreasing strain rate from 0.1 s⁻¹ to 0.01 s⁻¹ at 0.2 or 0.4 strains at 950 °C and (d) the increasing temperatures from 950 °C to 1050 °C in strain ranges of 0.2-0.3 or 0.4-0.5 at 0.01 s⁻¹.

The citing text states that under transiently increasing Z_P the DRXGs_I were larger than the DRXGs_II, consistent with the separation between the 'First stage' and 'Second stage' curves in Fig. 27a and 27b.
The citing text states that after transiently decreasing Z_P the DRXGs_I grew rapidly to nearly the constant-condition size and the AGS of DRXGs_II soon surpassed that of DRXGs_I (Fig. 27c and 27d).

The group is composite in layout only: all eight sub-plots are the same type of simulated average-grain-size-versus-strain curve, output of a 3D cellular automaton model, with no micrographs, maps or tables.

measured_quantities: ε₁ (strain at which the deformation condition changes)
unreadable_items: Panel letter annotations at the top-left corner of each image are partially cropped (the leading panel letter is cut off), so (a)-(d) were assigned by matching the printed T / ε̇ and legend entries to the caption.
No numeric data labels on any curve: grain-size values at given strains cannot be read exactly, only relative to the 35/70/105 µm gridlines.
The upper sub-plot of panel (a) shows only the 35/70/105 µm tick labels (the 0 label is cropped), so the vertical origin of that sub-plot is approximate.
Fine curve details in panels (d) upper and (d) lower (which dashed curve is first vs second stage) are only resolvable via colour/linestyle and are reported with low confidence.
